nodes.label: Decision Log: WorkflowHub Complexity Governance v2
Keep Five Stages, Delete Permission State Machine
nodes.rationale: Five stages each answer direction, spec, plan, implementation and independent verification, so their responsibilities are stable and directly protect quality; the accidents came from checkpoint/reopen/rebind/recovery/reset/generation/invalidation/revalidation/trace combinations, not from the number of stages. Removing the bypass permission state machine attacks the root cause without lowering delivery quality.

nodes.label: Four Current Materials Are the Working Truth
nodes.rationale: Multiple current selectors (requirements pointer, accepted checkpoint, reopen/rebind/recovery/reset) conflict; reusing the single existing task-material-revision.v1 and leaving history read-only keeps one current state while preserving old bytes and hashes for audit.

nodes.label: Quality Facts Append-Only, Publication Derived
nodes.rationale: Review, test, confirmation and authorization facts are worth keeping as original bytes, but turning them into work permits let old heads lock business tasks. Publication recomputes from current materials and facts once, satisfying both append-only audit and normal revision; completion predicates must stay few, direct and failable so derived logic cannot silently pass.

nodes.label: Per-Deletion Proof Card and Vertical Slices
nodes.rationale: Deletion risk cannot be judged from file names, so each candidate proves consumer/reverse references, preserved quality semantics, replacement path, the same negative oracle before and after, fault injection, Multica compatibility and a rollback commit. Missing any item means KEEP. The proof card stays an ordinary build-plan/build-code task field - it must never become a new state machine.

nodes.label: Irreplaceable Quality Primitives
nodes.rationale: TaskHandle safety, atomic canonical writes, current material revision, invocation authenticity, fresh tests, per-AC results, independent review, severe-finding handling and human authorization each protect identity, data, quality or irreversible operations, and consumer research confirmed they are still used by final build/verify, TaskHandle and Multica closure.

nodes.label: Multica Skill Bundle vs Local Runner Release
nodes.rationale: Multica only consumes stages and skills, so it needs the minimal runnable skill package; tests, history migration and dependency install belong to the Runner repo. node_modules is not committed and not bundled - only the lockfile installs it locally or in CI - which shrinks the Multica install surface without sacrificing local formal verification.

nodes.label: Tests Converge to Quality Predicates and Fault Injection
nodes.rationale: Deleting the state machines removes their combination space, so tests are designed against external quality predicates instead: five-stage E2E, material revision, severe findings, canonical write failure, legacy read-only/import and Skill Bundle clean-install. Every test deletion must be bound to a deleted capability and a replacement oracle, because a wrongly deleted unique oracle is the main risk.

nodes.label: Full File Inventory and Stable AGENTS.md Rules
nodes.rationale: A full tracked-file inventory (KEEP/MOVE/MERGE/DELETE/GENERATE/ARCHIVE) surfaces orphans, while AGENTS.md records only stable directory responsibilities and dependency direction so the rules do not drift the way a per-file list would.

nodes.label: ADR 0012 Current Materials Derived Publication
nodes.rationale: The decision is hard to reverse, future readers would otherwise wonder why historical mechanisms no longer participate in current runs, and it is a genuine trade-off between auditable history and low complexity - all three ADR conditions hold. The ADR supersedes ADR 0005/0008/0009/0011 and the relevant parts of ADR 0007/0002 while keeping deterministic identity, historical bytes, independent review and severe-finding handling.

nodes.label: Direction Review Finding F-6bf98330c313
nodes.rationale: The direction review verdict revise_required is preserved unchanged; the finding showed the original plan demanded per-item proof without defining a single recomputable deletion proof, so the repair added the proof card, vertical deletion slices, negative oracle, fault injection, Multica compatibility and rollback requirements.
